newsitem.title: CROATIA: DUTCH BREWER BAVARIA SAID IN CROATIA JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH BREWER BAVARIA SAID IN CROATIA JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Dutch brewer Bavaria has formed a joint venture with Croatian firm Malkos to produce and market its beer in Croatia, a local financial magazine reported on Monday.
A new company Bavaria Croatia would initially invest 22 million kuna into a beer production and bottling facility, said monthly Banka in its February edition.
It said local private bank Glumina Banka would back up the project, which will be expanded later into what was described as a "comprehensive beer production programme" under licence.
Malkos has been a representative and distributer of Bavaria beer in the Croatian market for the past five years.
No company officials were available for comment.
Several foreign brewers including Belgium's Interbrew and Compania Cervecerias Unidas SA of Chile have acquired majority stakes in Croatian breweries.
